newsitem.title: FINLAND: Pohjola to pay FIM 400-500 mln for Salama.
newsitem.headline: Pohjola to pay FIM 400-500 mln for Salama.

text.p: Finnish insurance group Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola said on Thursday it expected to pay 400-500 million markka when it buys the shares and business operations of Salama from its associate Suomi.
"Salama's share portfolio is worth 400 to 500 million markka, and Suomi owns 92 percent of it," Pirkko Alitalo told Reuters by telephone in response to a question.
"This is the net asset value," she added.
"The exact price will be determined after the closing of the books (for 1996)," Alitalo said.
Pohjola will report its 1996 results in mid-March. @
The purchase of the Salama portfolio is a key part of a plan Pohjola announced earlier on Thursday to restructure its life-insurance business.
